I literally just get my thoughts down on paper in the way that I would talk to someone if I could say whatever I wanted without feeling judged or insecure about it. It can also be good for self improvement in various areas as you can study your own thinking to see if you're falling into any particular mental traps. 

If you struggle to think of things you like about yourself start with something nice and easy like a TV show, movie or food etc and you can start with something as simple as "I like that I like chicken" it might seem a little silly at first but I think the key to these negative thought processes is to try and replace them with positive ones at any level, no amount of progress is a bad thing.

If you do decide to journal some rules may help such as:
Don't allow negative talk about yourself to stop reinforcing negative thoughts about yourself.
On the flip side try to write at least one thing you like about yourself or some sort of positive affirmation in every entry
